item.title: 10 Years of Let's Encrypt
item.description:
📝 In March 2016, we issued our one millionth certificate. Just two years later, in September 2018, we were issuing a million certificates every day. In 2020 we reached a billion total certificates issued and as of late 2025 we’re frequently issuing ten million certificates per day.
🔗 Read more: https://letsencrypt.org/2025/12/09/10-years

item.title: Agentic AI Foundation
item.description:
📝 Without collaborative open development, we risk missing the full potential of agentic AI where everyone benefits thanks to open standards, open protocols, and open systems on which other tools are built. What AAIF Will DoThe Agentic AI Foundation provides a neutral home where companies, researchers, and independent developers can collaborate on open source agentic AI. Founding ProjectsAAIF launches with contributions from Block, Anthropic, and OpenAI:goose, Block's open source agentic AI framework, will transition to community governance under AAIF.
🔗 Read more: https://block.xyz/inside/block-anthropic-and-openai-launch-the-agentic-ai-foundation
